# Gather Tomorrow LLC

> Gather Tomorrow LLC is an AI automation consulting firm for small businesses in the US and Taiwan, run by partners Angela and Sam. We build practical automations for payment reminders and customer inquiries using tools a business already has. Every message is reviewed before it goes out. Lead organizing is also described on the site. The site is available in English and Traditional Chinese (Taiwan).

Contact: support@gathertomorrow.com

## English

- [Home](https://kuankuan0126-stack.github.io/gathertomorrow-site/): overview
- [Services](https://kuankuan0126-stack.github.io/gathertomorrow-site/#services): what can be automated first — payment reminders, inquiry replies, lead organizing
- [Examples](https://kuankuan0126-stack.github.io/gathertomorrow-site/#examples): one payment-reminder workflow, with automatic steps and human review marked
- [How it works](https://kuankuan0126-stack.github.io/gathertomorrow-site/#how): understand the current process, confirm scope, test and hand over
- [Field notes](https://kuankuan0126-stack.github.io/gathertomorrow-site/#notes): short workflow notes
- [Payment reminders note](https://kuankuan0126-stack.github.io/gathertomorrow-site/notes/payment-reminders/): problem, tools, before and after
- [Inquiry replies note](https://kuankuan0126-stack.github.io/gathertomorrow-site/notes/inquiry-replies/): problem, tools, before and after
- [Lead organizing note](https://kuankuan0126-stack.github.io/gathertomorrow-site/notes/lead-organizing/): problem, tools, before and after
- [Tools](https://kuankuan0126-stack.github.io/gathertomorrow-site/tools/): consulting plans, then example tools that are in development and not for sale (prices TBD)
- [FAQ](https://kuankuan0126-stack.github.io/gathertomorrow-site/#faq): who we help, coding, consultations, and services. Pricing and project length are not published yet.
- [Book a consultation](https://kuankuan0126-stack.github.io/gathertomorrow-site/#book): after you send the form, we reply by email to set up a short call

- [首頁](https://kuankuan0126-stack.github.io/gathertomorrow-site/zh/): 總覽
- [服務](https://kuankuan0126-stack.github.io/gathertomorrow-site/zh/#services): 可以先自動化的三項——催款提醒、詢問回覆、名單整理
- [例子](https://kuankuan0126-stack.github.io/gathertomorrow-site/zh/#examples): 一個催款提醒流程，標出自動步驟與人工審核
- [怎麼進行](https://kuankuan0126-stack.github.io/gathertomorrow-site/zh/#how): 了解現在的流程、確認範圍、測試並交接
- [現場筆記](https://kuankuan0126-stack.github.io/gathertomorrow-site/zh/#notes): 短的流程筆記
- [催款提醒筆記](https://kuankuan0126-stack.github.io/gathertomorrow-site/zh/notes/payment-reminders/): 問題、工具與做法、之前與之後
- [詢問回覆筆記](https://kuankuan0126-stack.github.io/gathertomorrow-site/zh/notes/inquiry-replies/): 問題、工具與做法、之前與之後
- [名單整理筆記](https://kuankuan0126-stack.github.io/gathertomorrow-site/zh/notes/lead-organizing/): 問題、工具與做法、之前與之後
- [工具](https://kuankuan0126-stack.github.io/gathertomorrow-site/zh/tools/): 諮詢方案在前；範例工具在「開發中」，尚未開賣，價格待定
- [常見問題](https://kuankuan0126-stack.github.io/gathertomorrow-site/zh/#faq): 協助對象、是否需要寫程式、諮詢方式與服務範圍。價格與專案時長尚未公布。
- [預約諮詢](https://kuankuan0126-stack.github.io/gathertomorrow-site/zh/#book): 送出之後，我們會用電子郵件回覆，約一通短談
